notes: Corrected: the of Nun unit was headed on of; rule 24 heads of + noun on the noun, as every other rectum unit in the chapter is headed.
yinhalu is rendered by the light verb divide plus the complement for inheritance; the unit is headed on inheritance under rule 44, and the defensible alternative is to head it on divide.
Two the's are written for shemot ha-anashim, so the article takes the one before its own word and the construct a supplied one (rule 29).
